afterEn:
I’ve just finished setting you up. Here’s what you know about me:
{lines}

{goal}

How to work — keep me in the loop the whole way, don’t go quiet:
1. Reply right away, before looking at anything, with one line saying what you’re about to check and why.
2. Look in at most three places that matter for this: my calendar for the next two days, my inbox for unanswered threads, and the doc or channel most related to the task. Stop after three.
3. After EACH one, post a one-line note of what you found there (or that there was nothing useful) — immediately, not at the end.
4. Then write the first pass and put it in a document I can open, share and edit — create a file for it (or an artifact, if you can’t make files here), named for the task, with the full draft inside, not a summary of it. Rough and fast beats polished and late: headings and bullets are plenty; I want something to react to within a couple of minutes. In the chat, just say it’s ready and name the two or three things you most want my take on.
5. Finish with two other things from my week you could take on next.

Keep every update to a line or two.
